row.title: Accountable terminates verification services for MainStreet
row.description: Accountable ended its service relationship with MainStreet after stating that MainStreet did not meet its verification standards, removing the previously available public reserve-verification path.

row.title: msUSD suffers severe market depeg
row.description: msUSD traded materially below its intended one-dollar peg after the verification-provider termination, with reporting placing the intraday low near nine cents.

row.title: A single vendor termination just wiped 88% off a stablecoin that called itself institutional-grade

row.description: The reviewed sources do not establish one day-level MainStreetUSD launch boundary.
The exact Accountable primary-post URL and timestamp for the service termination have not yet been preserved in the evidence layer.
Current USDC reserve sufficiency and any reserve deficit remain unconfirmed after public verification visibility was lost.
Current successful redemption volume, waiting time, capacity usage, rejection rate, and settlement performance are not established.
A complete issuer response addressing the verification termination, reserve status, and recovery mechanism has not been normalized.
A temporary price rebound does not establish sustainable recovery to the one-dollar peg.
Realized losses, bad debt, liquidations, oracle failures, or withdrawal restrictions in msY-linked lending and vault systems are not yet established for SOG.

row.title: World Liberty Financial announces plans for USD1
row.description: World Liberty Financial and BitGo publicly introduced USD1 and described plans for issuance on Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain. The announcement used future-oriented launch language and is recorded as an introduction rather than the canonical public launch.

row.title: World Liberty Financial proposes USD1 airdrop test
row.description: World Liberty Financial proposed distributing a small amount of USD1 to test on-chain airdrop functionality and described the exercise as preparation before broader market access.

row.title: USDH enters migration period
row.description: USDH entered a migration and liquidity-transition period while remaining fully backed and supported through designated routes.
The exact first public launch, first mint, and first external circulation boundary remain unresolved.
The complete issuing-entity terms, holder claims, eligibility, fees, minimums, settlement timing, and emergency controls remain incomplete.
HyperCore token identity, linked HyperEVM contract, linking controls, deployer, mint, pause, and upgrade authorities remain incomplete.
The migration start, treasury-deployer transition, final support date, redemption end state, and successor-liquidity boundary remain unresolved.
The complete reserve allocation, custodian, monthly attestation, and ecosystem-contribution income chronology remains incomplete.
